Container.Name: Warracker
Container.Overview:
Warracker is a self-hosted warranty tracker. Keep track of all your warranties, receipts, and manuals in one place — with expiry notifications, document storage (local or Paperless-ngx), tags, claims, and CSV import/export.
REQUIRES PostgreSQL: install a PostgreSQL container first (e.g. the official postgres template), create a database and user, then point DB_HOST/DB_NAME/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD below at it.
Container.Description: Warracker is a self-hosted warranty tracker. Keep track of all your warranties, receipts, and manuals in one place.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Warracker web interface (container listens on 80).

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Persistent storage for uploaded invoices, manuals, and photos.

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: PostgreSQL host. Install a PostgreSQL container first, then use its IP address (find it under Docker -> container -> IP) or container name.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Secret key for Flask sessions and JWT. Generate a random string (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: FRONTEND_URL
Config.Description: Public URL of the frontend (used for redirects).

Config.Name: APP_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of the application (used in email links).

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: SMTP host for password resets and notifications (optional).

Config.Name: WARRACKER_MEMORY_MODE
Config.Description: Memory profile: optimized (default), ultra-light, or performance.
